possibilities.connection: On 2026-11-12 Magpie suggested banks barred from code APIs give developers a local coding agent on ordinary machines, and today's open pi LoRA reportedly lifts the same base model, Qwen3.8-27B, from 29.4% to 62.7% on SWE-bench Pro Hard, while Omarchy's TensorFold recipes package that base model for local runs.

appearances.title: DHH's blind overnight Omarchy eval: Inkling 2 Mini scores 8.50 vs Qwen3.8 27B 8.00 on a 48-64 GB RTX Spark
appearances.summary: DHH gave three local models the same Omarchy jobs overnight (a theme, a plugin, an app and a game), judged blind out of 10: Inkling 2 Mini scored 8.50 and finished all 8 runs in 142 minutes, Qwen3.8 27B 8.00 with 7 of 8 in 240 minutes, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 4.38. Omarchy has added Inkling 2 Mini to its local model catalog and published a reproducible measurement: 32.7 GB loaded and about 78 to 92 tok/
